All Addi. Central Provident Fund Commissioners

Sub- Data entry in legal dashboard -reg.
Sir

Please refer to this office letter no. LC-9(13)2013/ACC Pending Ref./99,
dated 01-04-2015 addressed to all Zona! Additional Central Provident Fund
Commisioner regarding complete data entry in respect of Legal Dash Board. in

continuation of this letter, it is once again requested to make all the entries in
legal dash board properly, so that there is no difference or discrepancy.

2. Recently on verification It has been noticed that still the data entered in
the Legal Dash Board does not tally with the returns filed at Head Office by the
Regional Offices/Sub-Regional Offices.

3. From now onwards returns to Ministry of Labour & Employment, replies
to VIP queries and Parliament questions and for other purposes as well, data
will be extracted from Legal Dashboard only. Hence, it is the responsibility of
Regional P. F. Commissioner-|/Officer-in-Charge and Nodal Officers to keep the
Legal Dash Board updated on daily basis. Concerned RPFCs/OICs will be held
responsible in case of any discrepancy of data or incomplete data on legal
dashboard.

4, Further, it was also directed vide Head Office Circular/letter No. LC-
9(13)2013/ACC Pending Ref/41166 , dated 04-03-2015 that nodal officers have
to furnish their official NIC e-mail id only on Legal Dashboard. This direction
has not been complied by as many as 82 offices, the list of such nodal officers
enclosed. The Regional Provident Fund Commissioner-l/Officer-in-charge of
such offices are directed to comply with Head Office direction by 11-05-2015
positively and report back to Head Office.

5. In addition to above All Zonal ACCs are once again requested to send a
certificate regarding 100% entry of data on legal dashboard by 10th May 2015.

Yours’ Faithfully,

Encl- As above. cae —
